front.title: PSI-04: State-Chain Receipts for Records Concerning Vulnerable Persons

abstract.t:
This document defines PSI-04, a domain profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for records about vulnerable persons, such as clinical-trial participants and recipients of disability or aged care services. PSI-04 seals each state transition of a record as a PSI receipt chained to the previous one, so that later alteration or omission of a transition is detectable. Only digests are sealed; no personal data leaves the record holder. PSI-04 shows integrity and ordering only and does not show that care was adequate or that any regulation was met.
This revision withdraws the multi-party computation and zero- knowledge claims of revision 00 and the request for a URI scheme.
